sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2012. An Atlas of Nigerian Languages, edition III. Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation. Entry 206 'Jan Awei' (p. 41 of the Atlas index) and classification list p. 98.
sources.note: Nothing on stress or phonology. Entire entry verbatim: '206. Jan Awei / 1.B Jan Awei / 3. Gombe State, West of Muri mountains, North of the Benue (precise location unknown) / 4. 12 ? (1997) / 5. Benue-Congo: Central Jukunoid / Source(s) Storch (p.c.)'. No field 9 (linguistic publications) and no Refs., i.e. the Atlas knows of no linguistic data at all. In the classification list (p. 98) it appears as 'Kororofa cluster: Abinsi, Wapan, Hone, Jan Awei ?'.

Low expectation of any Jan-Awei data.
